Last Thursday, Eva and Tom went to the food festival. Eva usually has fish for breakfast. Eva wrote about the day in the diary. The harvest needs more manpower than usual this year.
They took many photos at the family kitchen. The food festival is one of the best places in the city. Eva drinks milk after doing sports. The cookies smell wonderful.
The weather was windy that day. Eva and Tom had great fun there. Tom is interested in drawing. Best of all, grandma's soup recipe is a family secret.
Eva hopes to visit Paris one day. Eva is going to travel to Paris in April. There are always many people at the family kitchen.
